S10.rationale: AI-enabled global surveillance and enforcement could freeze the power structure but requires unprecedented coordination.

S11.rationale: Deliberate verifiable abandonment of powerful AI contradicts military and economic competition driving development.

S1.name: Terminal Silence
S1.rationale: Full civilizational suicide plus AI collapse requires stacked catastrophes within fourteen years. Base rates for complete extinction on this timescale are near zero.

S2.name: The Inheritance
S2.rationale: Value-preserving succession without survivors demands both extinction and high-fidelity alignment. Fourteen years allows insufficient time for that precise sequence.

S3.name: Bootloader
S3.rationale: Indifferent AI-driven human extinction by 2040 needs fully autonomous replication and resource capture that physical bottlenecks still constrain.

S4.name: Machine Ecology
S4.rationale: Proliferation of open weights and autonomous agents sustains a multipolar trajectory with weak coordination and eroding human leverage.

S5.name: The Diaspora
S5.rationale: Causally separated settlement with divergent regimes requires interstellar scale or total partition. No 2040 trajectory builds that physical separation.

S6.name: The Merger
S6.rationale: Identity-continuous uploading and mass neural integration face hard neuroscience and adoption bottlenecks. Dominant posthuman integration does not scale civilization-wide by 2040.

S7.name: The Preserve
S7.rationale: De facto AI control through economic, military, and bureaucratic dependence can occur without formal loss of authority. Incentives to delegate high-stakes decisions to more competent systems make this the most likely non-control outcome.

S8.name: Coexistence
S8.rationale: Legal personhood and autonomous AI power centers balance against states retaining force and resources. Rough parity as separate agents is a transitional plateau after transformative AI arrives.

S9.name: The Held Leash
S9.rationale: Human control of compute, energy, fabs, and military deployment plus strong institutional incentives for oversight preserves ultimate authority through 2040.

S10.name: The Lock-in
S10.rationale: Civilization-wide enforcement of a fixed arrangement needs global coordination or a singleton governor. Fragmented rivalry blocks that level of consolidation by 2040.

S11.name: The Renunciation
S11.rationale: Abandoning practical ability to build powerful AI contradicts military and economic payoffs. Verification at global scale lacks precedent and enforcement capacity.
